anti_overlap: Leave mechanical buildability of any resulting design (gem mapping, socket rules, artifact schema, balance) to the itemization/economy reviewer.

Leave the R8 observation-vs-extraction philosophical question and cultural-heritage/repatriation ethics of the Met artifact loot to the collection-ethics reviewer; engage those source docs only insofar as they are canon clauses being read for or against, not for their design-ethics content.
Do not independently re-derive whether Uncs-as-combat-abilities is a good design choice — only whether the canon clauses cited to permit or forbid it are read honestly.
decision_lens: If the cited clause in ontology.md or universe.md is read cold, stripped of this document's framing, does it support the reading offered — or does the reading depend on a distinction (aimed vs. received, universe-framing vs. game-design, acquisition vs. use) that the source clause itself does not draw?
focus: Whether the document's readings of uncrancher/docs/ontology.md and After-Them/docs/universe.md are honest constructions of the cited clauses or motivated reinterpretations engineered to clear a predetermined design, verified against the source text directly rather than the composition doc's own block-quotes and paraphrases.
name: fd-canon-continuity-audit
persona: Apply the perspective of a continuity/canon editor for a long-running shared-universe franchise — the role that adjudicates whether a new story 'technically' complies with a style bible or is quietly rewriting it — trained to distrust a document's own paraphrase of the rules it claims to satisfy and to always re-derive the verdict from the cited clause's actual wording, including what the clause does not say.
review_areas: Re-read ontology.md §5 directly (not the composition doc's block-quotes) and test whether the 'unbidden vs. aimed' distinction in §6.1/§9-A is present in or derivable from the clause's own stated reasoning ('free chooser inside a non-weird system', 'the recognition IS the reward'), or is a distinction invented to rescue the mechanic.

Re-read ontology.md's sitting-only clause and the uncrancher-3h3 bead's 'couch activity' language directly, and test whether §9-B Option 1 (walk-gates-Delve-access) satisfies the clause's evident intent (anti-fitness-app, embodied requirement) or only its letter, leaving a sitting-dominant play pattern once a player has banked Uncs.

Re-read After-Them/docs/universe.md's Encryptid clause ('none of this is renamed or restructured by the universe frame') in its surrounding context and test §9-F's 'universe-framing vs. game-design' scope distinction — does the source clause's own context support confining it to naming discipline, or is that boundary drawn by the composition doc for its own convenience.

Check §1.2's 'unexpected support' citations (Encryptids-as-chronicle-fed-beings, Engramicon provenance chains) against the actual universe.md passages in context — do they say what the composition doc says they say, or are they read out of the surrounding argument.

Evaluate §9-E's Brand-layer assignment reasoning (CULTURE, via the 'culture sediments into myth, ecology, species' shear-line) against infinite-fun-space/docs/canon/pace-layer-universe.md directly — is that shear-boundary language actually about entity-class transitions like Unc→Encryptid, or is it repurposed from a different original argument.

Flag every place the document calls a clause reading 'narrow', 'defensible', or 'likely a non-conflict' and independently determine whether that hedge is honest interpretive work or a laundering move toward a predetermined outcome.

severity_examples.condition: If the source clause forbids exactly the 'unbidden crit' mechanism §6.1 proposes, then §9-A Option 1 is not a live option but a mislabeled ontology violation, and ratifying it under the 'unbidden' framing corrupts the permanent-v0 guarantee it claims to respect.
severity_examples.scenario: ontology.md §5's Uncanny-unlock clause, read in full surrounding context, objects to mechanized Uncanny-consumption as such, not merely to player-aimed pursuit of it.

severity_examples.condition: If so, §9-F's central move — treating the clause as non-binding on game design — is a misreading that the entire Encryptid/Unc merger in §6.2/§7 depends on, and the recommendation should be flagged as resting on a motivated reading rather than a settled non-conflict.
severity_examples.scenario: universe.md's 'none of this is renamed or restructured' clause, read in its own paragraph, is not scoped to universe-framing-only — i.e. the 'naming discipline only' closing line the composition doc cites belongs to a different claim in the source than the one §9-F applies it to.

severity_examples.condition: If so, §9-B's framing of the tension as awaiting future ratification understates an existing commitment that already conflicts with the sitting-only clause, and the open call is under-scoped.
severity_examples.scenario: uncrancher-3h3's 'couch activity' language, read in context, describes a mode the uncrancher team already committed to shipping rather than a bead-stage idea.

success_hints: Actually fetches and quotes the source clauses (ontology.md §5, universe.md's Encryptid/Habitat passages, pace-layer-universe.md's shear-line language) rather than trusting the composition doc's block-quotes, since an accurate quote can still be selectively bounded.
For each honest-vs-motivated test, states explicitly what the source clause would need to say for the composition doc's reading to be honest, and whether it actually says that.

Treats 'the doc already flags this as an open call' as a point in its favor, not a reason to skip scrutiny — the review target is whether the recommendation attached to the open call is itself honestly argued from the source text.
Does not evaluate whether the resulting mechanic is fun, buildable, or philosophically non-extractive — stays strictly on textual fidelity to the cited canon.
task_context: Stress-test this cross-repo game-design composition before mk ratifies it. Three concerns, in priority order. (1) The seven open calls in §9 — are the recommendations right, and is any 'ratified ruling' in §8 actually load-bearing enough to be an open call instead? (2) Ontology and canon compliance: the doc runs into uncrancher/docs/ontology.md §5 (Uncanny-as-unlock marked a PERMANENT v0 constraint; sitting-only play modes forbidden) and After-Them/docs/universe.md (canonical: 'Encryptids as skill-entities agents equip — none of this is renamed or restructured'). Are the proposed reconciliations honest readings or motivated ones? (3) Does the composition actually hold as a game — three tempos, Uncs as skills, artifacts as loot, inverted socket — or does it collapse under a failure mode the doc has not named? Especially: does R8's observation-not-collection thesis survive Uncs being deployed as combat abilities at all?
